contradictions.what: Rep first names CTO Raj as final decider, then says Angela signed with Adyen and retreats to 'Probably Angela'.
Raj was the contact throughout and Angela was met only once, yet Angela signed and her team drove the store workshop.
Rep says we were ahead before the workshop, but unified commerce got silence, Bev called it a diagram, and the return flow was never shown.
We also offered one contract for stores and online, yet the competitor's one-platform, one-contract pitch is treated as differentiating.
'I described it' is later shown to mean the return flow was only described and never demonstrated.
